name: deltac_all
mod: process.hgcalLayerClustersEE.plugin.deltac = cms.vdouble(VALUE, VALUE, VALUE, VALUE); process.hgcalLayerClustersHSi.plugin.deltac = cms.vdouble(VALUE, VALUE, VALUE, VALUE); process.hgcalLayerClustersHSci.plugin.deltac = cms.vdouble(VALUE/1.3*0.0315, VALUE/1.3*0.0315, VALUE/1.3*0.0315, VALUE/1.3*0.0315)
info: Local density cut-off distance (d_c) in all parts together (EE, HSi, HSci; HFNose ignored). VALUE is applied directly in silicon units (EE, HSi); HSci is rescaled by its default ratio to silicon (0.0315/1.3) to keep the same relative knob in scintillator units. Default value is 1.3 (0.0315 for HSci).
